subject: Copywriting
title: Urgency: Real vs. Manufactured
description: A micro-lesson that makes Urgency: Real vs. Manufactured usable.

hook.text: 'Respond by midnight Friday or lose this offer forever.' Real urgency drives action. Fake urgency drives unsubscribes.

buildup.text: Urgency works because of Kahneman's loss aversion: the fear of missing the deal hurts more than the joy of getting it.

discovery.text: The most honest urgency: limited inventory, early-bird pricing, or event deadlines.

twist.text: Countdown timers that reset when you clear cookies destroyed trust in urgency.

climax.text: Sustainable urgency comes from genuine scarcity, not manipulation.

punchline.text: Real deadlines drive action. Fake ones drive distrust forever.

quiz.question: What is the best type of urgency in a sales letter?
options: Real constraints like limited inventory or event deadlines
